external_corroboration.finding: Identity confirmed: Andraž Šporar (b. 27 February 1994, Slovenia), forward (Wikipedia: Slovan Bratislava; UEFA DOB 27/2/1994 exact match). The person is verified; the kit reflects his most recent club move, not the supplied label.

warnings: kit verification corrected 2026-10-18: the earlier 'unexpected kit (Olimpija Ljubljana)' claim was a misidentification — visual verification of this cutoff shows a genuine ŠK Slovan Bratislava kit (royal blue, adidas, niké 'je tipovanie' gold sponsor, circular crest with the white double cross on three hills; NK Olimpija Ljubljana wear green/white Puma 2026/27). The July 2026 Olimpija transfer is real, but his UEFA Champions League registration and this cutoff both remain Slovan — kit matches the supplied label.
